fieldNotes.truckGate: Chain-link sliding/swing gate across the main vehicle drive off Cowles Lane, seen open in Street View looking south from pano QWYYVCSlPkR7nSD6tyRZXw. Perimeter is chain-link fenced along the road frontage.
fieldNotes.guardShack: No staffed booth visible at the gate or front lot in satellite or Street View; gate is a manual chain-link slide gate. Hence remoteGs=true.
fieldNotes.dockDoors: Counted from z19-z20: east building face ~5-6 dock positions (trailers backed in) plus south/SW canopy docks ~4-6; banded 10-25, ~16 estimate. Some doors obscured.
fieldNotes.dropArea: Two large unpaved drop-yard clusters east of the building hold ~50-60 trailers in angled rows; capacity 80+. dropYard=true.
fieldNotes.fastLaneOpportunity: Wide unpaved/gravel gate apron and large internal yard with ample paved width to add a bypass lane.
fieldNotes.urbanRural: Edge-of-town Albany GA; surrounded by light residential to the west and open fields/woods, small-town industrial. Rural per rubric.
fieldNotes.buildingCount: Main plant building plus a north annex/covered structure and adjacent older warehouses on the same fenced parcel.
fieldNotes.shipRcvSeparate: Docks on east face and south/SW face; could be ship/rcv split but not clearly distinct clusters from imagery — left false, flagged uncertain.
